4. The condition at IF1 checks if the amount requested to withdraw is less than or equal to max and that max is greater than 0.
5. Since the withdrawal process only allows the owner to withdraw their own deposits, there is no evidence of any balance being increased (MINT) or any unauthorized balance being decreased (LEAK).
6. The function does not restrict or limit the ability of other users to withdraw their own funds, thus it does not implement LIMIT behavior.
7. Therefore, this path does not exhibit any rugpull behavior.
